propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Raymundum paenitentiae sacramenti insignem ministrum
elegisti, et per maris undas mirabiliter traduxisti: concede; ut ejus
intercessione dignos paenitentiae fructus facere, et ad aeternae salutis
portum pervenire valeamus. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, Who didst choose blessed Raymund to be an eminent minister of the sacrament of Penance, and didst wondrously bring him through the waves of the sea, grant that by his intercession we may have the grace to bring forth fruits worthy of penance and to reach the port of eternal safety. Through our Lord.
